correctness.rationale: In the 2021 primary Theorem 4, the step ||a+b||^2<=||a||^2+||b||^2 is false; a cross term is omitted. On any measurable partition, Hilbert direct-integral Minkowski gives E_i(sigma_j;f)^(1/2) <=D_ij(sigma_j;f)^(1/2)+E_j(sigma_j;f)^(1/2) <=(1+sqrt(M))E_j(sigma_j;f)^(1/2), hence each cross-energy <=(1+sqrt M)^2 selected energy. Summing individual K-g-frame lower bounds gives exact lower universal constant A/[1+(m-1)(1+sqrt M)^2], and upper sum B. For each m>=2, M>0, one-point scalar Lambda_1=I, Lambda_i=(1+sqrt M)I for i>=2 and K=I satisfies all pairwise hypotheses (difference squared=M against min{1,c^2}=1) with A=1+(m-1)c^2; assigning point to family 1 gives exact energy 1, equal to corrected lower bound, while published bound A/[1+(m-1)(M+1)]>1. Independently checked m=2,3,5, M=.01,.4,9. This is an exact analytic all-m/all-M counterexample and sharp replacement, not a finite extrapolation.
